name: vapi-mcp
description: Vapi MCP server: drive the Vapi voice-agent platform from any MCP client — create voice agents, manage phone numbers, and make/receive phone calls. Install as a Hermes plugin to wire Vapi into your Hermes workflow via MCP tools (vapi_create_assistant, vapi_list_assistants, vapi_create_call, vapi_end_call, etc.).
